correctness.rationale: For square-zero maximal-rank pairs, image equals kernel. Complementary images force a direct decomposition, with both interspace restriction maps invertible, giving the canonical pair (X0,Y_C). Simultaneous conjugations preserving both image spaces reduce to diag(P,P), and hence C similarity. Alternating products yield all four matrix units with coefficients k[C], including inverse powers since C is invertible, giving exactly M_2(k[C]) of dimension 4 deg μ_C. The complement and isomorphism choices are independent and exact. Standard rational-canonical centralizer sizes and cyclic companion matrices count each polynomial degree. All d from 1 to m occur by unipotent Jordan construction. Finite checker independently tests word-span algebra dimensions and a full binary four-dimensional transverse stratum; symbolic proof covers all fields.

value.rationale: It classifies the complete natural open maximal-rank transverse stratum in the representation variety of pairs of square-zero operators by an ordinary invertible similarity problem, identifies generated algebra types and the entire finite-field rank spectrum with frequencies, and provides a quantitative extremality criterion.
